testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/verify-configurable-product-details-for-retail-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout > verify configurable product details for retail user

scenario.summary: A registered retail user signs in, adds a configurable product (default variant, qty 5), checks the variant's Bulb Size/Color/Technology rows and name in the order summary, selects Custom Flat Rate shipping, removes the account's auto-applied voucher, applies a voucher (Amount To Be Paid math), checks invalid voucher and coupon messages, applies a valid coupon (order-total math), pays with Vantiv Express, checks the receipt and logs out.
steps: Sign in with the dedicated retail account (username/password from the test data).
addProductOfAnyType(configurableProduct, 5) adds the default variant; open the cart.
Proceed to checkout: configurable attribute rows of variantSku; productNameLink(productId) equals productName; select Ship Complete + Custom Flat Rate; remove the auto-applied voucher.
Apply voucherNumber: voucher row number, Voucher Amount / Amount To Be Paid labels, order total - voucher = amount to be paid; remove the voucher.
Apply an invalid voucher and an invalid coupon: error messages.
Apply the coupon: success message, discount visible, Handling Charges, order-total math.
Fill project name and additional information, pay with Vantiv Express, check the receipt (thank-you banner, job name = projectName), log out.
stateChanges: Registered user's cart filled with the configurable product
A new order is placed for the user, paid by card (Vantiv Express), with the coupon; one coupon redemption is used
assertions: Configurable attribute rows equal 'Bulb Size : Small', 'Color : White', 'Technology : LED'
Voucher row equals voucherNumber; Voucher Amount / Amount To Be Paid labels; |order total - voucher - to be paid| <= 0.05
Coupon success message; discount visible; Handling Charges label; order-total math within 0.05
Thank-you banner visible; receipt job name equals projectName; Sign In heading after logout
evidence: Title and the five step labels match the flow.
Credentials (masked) name the existing registered user: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true (credential source).

configurableProduct B-100000: tda rows shows PimProductId 666, active ConfigurableProduct 'Philips Base B22 9-Watt Bulb'. productId 532 / productName / variantSku z-2510001 are the default variant (PimProductId 532). PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS quantityUsed 5, minVariants 1, variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology (as in the approved cart entries).

Re-mapped (product outputs 2026-11-01): productId 532 -> output variant1ProductId of PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS (PimProductId of the same variant as variant1Sku/variant1Name; tda rows: z-2510001 has PimProductId 532, and its published ZnodeProductId is also 532, so the storefront line id is the PIM id).

Derived assertions: '<attribute label> : <value>' rows stay expected-output; the migrated spec composes them from variant1Attr1..3 (values) and the attribute labels. No label output: attr1Label..attr3Label did not fit the configurable query (schema limit 8000 characters); the labels are fixed by variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology (tda rows ZnodePimAttributeLocale, locale 1: 'Bulb Size', 'Color', 'Technology'). DOUBT: addProductOfAnyType adds the PDP default variant; variant1 is the first qualifying variant by SKU, which may differ.

coupon TESTCHECKOUT (promotion Testim_CheckoutPageCoupon): tda rows shows an Amount Off Order coupon of store MaxwellsHardware (PortalId 7), discount 10, order minimum 10, coupon required, allowed with other coupons, no profile; mapped to COUPON_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER (collection, creates a fresh coupon per run; output couponCode). The test does not assert the discount amount (only the totals math read from the page).

DOUBT: the asserted coupon success message ('- Coupon applied successfully.') may be the promotion's PromotionMessage (the recorded coupon's message is 'Coupon Applied Successfully'); the COUPON_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER collection creates 'Coupon Applied Successfully'. If the page shows the promotion message, this assertion depends on the coupon data. The approved cart coupon entries (ORDER15, message 'Coupon Applied Successfully', asserted 'Coupon applied successfully.') suggest the page shows a fixed resource string instead.

Re-mapped (voucher keys 2026-11-01): voucherNumber BWUNS82SR1 -> need voucher (VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER), output voucherNumber, preferred (the test's own voucher first); read-only: applied and removed, no order placed with it

Ownership (core 0.13.0, 2026-11-01): the voucher must be the one restricted to the declared account: need voucher links owner to @user.userId (VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER gc.UserId = @owner), so it resolves at test start when the test declares the account (testData.useExisting); the test's own voucher is still tried first (preferred) and a fallback is restricted to this same account

checkoutPage.selectShippingMethod clicks Ship Complete and then lblShippingMethodFLAT (Custom Flat Rate): SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE, shippingCode FLAT. tda rows: ZnodeShipping FLAT is Custom, DestinationCountryCode US, so countries 'us' (the address itself is masked).
Profile (atstage 2026-10-31) has no observations for the checkout specs: every source is profiled false. Values were checked read-only with `tda rows` where noted.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every migrated webstore spec runs on (as in the approved shopping-cart and PDP entries); not named in the scan.
MISSING KEY: a credit-card payment method (Vantiv Express via Spreedly) offered on the store to the registered profile; need left out. Card values (masked) kept as config.
projectName and additionalInformation are typed into the order (created-by-test); invalidVoucher/invalidCoupon are deliberately invalid codes (config).

migrate (kept): the attribute rows are composed from the variant data (swap rule 3 fails); productId is now covered by variant1ProductId. No data value in the spec code (B-100000, z-2510001 and BWUNS82SR1 appear only in comments).
